notes.title: Full Game Release!
notes.notes:
Finally! The time has come for [b]Infinite Minigolf[/b] to leave Early Access and release as a [b]full game[/b] on Steam!

Let me say thank you in the name of the whole development team to all of you who supported us during the Early Access period. Your feedback was invaluable in shaping the game to its final form. [b]You are the best![/b]

With this update, we are adding the long awaited [b]VR support[/b] to Infinite Minigolf. I hope many of you can experience the game that way, as it really brings a new level of immersion to it. Meeting the well known characters up close and personal was a blast for me personally :)

We are also adding support for [b]Russian localization[/b] - the latest, but hopefully not the last update of supported languages.

So, is this the end of the road? Not at all! It's just the beginning of a new period in the life of Infinite Minigolf. With the cross-platform content sharing letting console players contribute to the ever-growing number of user created courses we feel that our community was never so active. We plan to continue supporting the game with [b]new content and feature updates[/b] - but I don't want to get ahead of myself.

I hope you will get as much fun playing our game as we had creating it.
Best regards,

Tamas 'Immortal' Balog
[i]Head of Studio[/i]
Zen Studios
